Congratulations on completing the Phase 1 Skills Bootcamp! 🎉 You are now a certified Robotics Explorer. But this is just the beginning of your journey! 

To help you take your physical V4.0 Smart Car to the next level and prepare for the **World Robot Olympiad (WRO) 2026** competition under the theme *"Robots Meet Culture"*, use this interactive roadmap to plan your next creation.

Choose your next robotics quest below! Each card has a direct, fun, and working link to explore.

### 🧠 Quest 1: Pro Coding (Modular Programs)
As your robot code gets bigger, putting everything in one file becomes a mess. Learn how to write neat, professional programs using C++ classes and custom libraries!

*   **[Adafruit: Multi-Tasking the Arduino](https://learn.adafruit.com/multi-tasking-the-arduino-part-1){target="_blank"}**
    *   *What it is:* A famous tutorial showing how to replace slow, blocking `delay()` statements with state-machine timers so your robot can do multiple things at once. It assumes you're already comfortable with basic Arduino sketches.
*   **[Arduino Docs: Writing Custom Libraries](https://docs.arduino.cc/learn/contributions/arduino-creating-library-guide){target="_blank"}**
    *   *What it is:* The official guide to bundling your motor controls, line sensors, or radar code into your own custom, reusable library.
:::
:::
:::

::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-6}
::: {.card .h-100}
::: {.card-body}
### 📈 Quest 2: Drive in a Perfect Straight Line (PID)
Have you noticed your robot wobbles when it drives, or doesn't go completely straight? Proportional-Integral-Derivative (PID) is the secret math formula used in real self-driving cars to keep motion perfectly smooth!

*   **[MATLAB Tech Talk: PID Control Video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=UR0hOmjaHp0){target="_blank"}**
    *   *What it is:* A super fun, animated video that shows exactly how PID controllers work using clear visuals and examples.
*   **[MATLAB Tech Talks: "Understanding PID Control" Playlist](https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLn8PRpmsu08pQBgjxYFXSsODEF3Jqmm-y){target="_blank"}**
    *   *What it is:* The full animated series — short follow-up videos that build on the intro one piece at a time. Great for binge-watching when you want to really get PID.
:::
:::
:::

::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-6}
::: {.card .h-100}
::: {.card-body}
### 📶 Quest 3: Control from Your Phone (ESP32 & IoT)
Upgrade your Arduino Uno to the dual-core **ESP32** chip to get built-in Wi-Fi and Bluetooth. You can build beautiful mobile dashboards to steer your car remotely!

*   **[Arduino Cloud (free tier + School plan)](https://cloud.arduino.cc/){target="_blank"}**
    *   *What it is:* The official Arduino IoT platform. Drag-and-drop dashboards in your browser, plus a phone app ("IoT Remote") to control your robot from anywhere. Has a free tier and a School plan with Google Classroom integration.
*   **[DroneBot Workshop: ESP32 Introduction](https://dronebotworkshop.com/esp32-intro/){target="_blank"}**
    *   *What it is:* A visual, video-led tour of what the ESP32 can do and how to start using it. An adult can help with the one-time Arduino IDE setup, then you're off building.
:::
:::
:::

::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-6}
::: {.card .h-100}
::: {.card-body}
### 👁️ Quest 4: Give Your Robot AI Eyes (Computer Vision)
Want your robot to recognize your face, follow a colored ball, or scan QR codes? It's easier than you think using plug-and-play AI camera modules!

*   **[HuskyLens: Plug-and-Play AI Camera (DFRobot)](https://www.dfrobot.com/product-1922.html){target="_blank"}**
    *   *What it is:* An easy AI camera with a screen that learns objects and colors at the press of a button. The product page links to 40+ tutorials and AI Fundamentals courses for Grades 6–10 — no complex AI coding required!
*   **[Google Teachable Machine](https://teachablemachine.withgoogle.com/){target="_blank"}**
    *   *What it is:* Train your own machine learning model in seconds using your webcam right in the browser, then export it to run on a Raspberry Pi!
:::
:::
:::

::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-6}
::: {.card .h-100}
::: {.card-body}
### 🛠️ Quest 5: Prototyping & Design Playgrounds
Design your own physical parts for 3D printing and test your circuits in virtual sandboxes.

*   **[Wokwi: Arduino Browser Simulator](https://wokwi.com/){target="_blank"}**
    *   *What it is:* A super accurate circuit simulator where you can wire up components and write code without any physical boards!
*   **[Autodesk Tinkercad 3D Design](https://www.tinkercad.com/){target="_blank"}**
    *   *What it is:* A simple, block-based 3D modeling tool. Perfect for designing custom chassis parts and mechanical gear!
:::
:::
